author: Digital Foundry
description:
Video sponsored by Remedy and Nvidia. Armed with the latest iteration of its Northlight Engine, developer Remedy opens the scale of its sequel to a wide open city space. Its ray tracing - and path tracing - features are also expanded over Alan Wake 2's, allowing for a radical overhaul to lighting, shading and reflections. On an Nvidia RTX 5090 it's possible to strike spectacular results - while technologies like DLSS, ray reconstruction and frame gen also help push its visuals to greater heights.
